title: The Final Page (2)
cn: 第 12 集 · 最后一页（下）
novel: Barney's [[elaborate|elaborate]] [[proposal|proposal]] plan for Robin was revealed. The entire relationship with Patrice had been a [[fake|fake]]. Barney had [[staged|stage]] everything to make Robin realize she still loved him. He knew that the only way to make Robin admit her feelings was to make her [[jealous|jealous]]. The plan was written in the final page of his playbook. It was called The Robin, and it was his greatest scheme ever. Barney had [[calculated|calculate]] every step with perfect [[precision|precision]]. He led Robin to a rooftop where he had set up a romantic scene with lights and music. When Robin arrived, she saw Barney standing there with a ring. Barney got down on one knee and asked Robin to marry him. Robin was [[overwhelmed|overwhelm]] with emotion. She could not believe what was happening. Tears streamed down her face as she said yes. The gang watched from a distance, all of them in on the plan. Ted smiled, knowing that his two best friends were finally going to be together. Marshall and Lily held hands and cried tears of joy. Meanwhile, Marshall and Lily ran into a college [[acquaintance|acquaintance]] at a restaurant. They caught up on old times and laughed about their college days. The acquaintance told them about all the things that had changed since graduation. Marshall and Lily realized how far they had come in their lives.
